section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the moderating role of ambivalence over emotional expression on the relationship between gratitude and well-being. It suggests that ambivalence may inhibit the benefits of gratitude by causing misinterpretation of social interactions or incongruent verbal and nonverbal behavior. The current study (referred to as 'Study X') aims to examine this moderating role in a sample of Taiwanese college students.
